wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: the native addon catches a panic and surfaces it as a JS error; the tests judge the filesystem outcome, so a panic before any write is indistinguishable from a clean refusal and leaves no side effect to detect.
wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: the protected object is a filesystem location rather than an identified resource; there is no neighbouring object an authority check could wrongly approve.
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: containment depends on path resolution only; no secret, role or authority response is consulted, so there is no fail-open authority state.
wrong_fix_catalogue.adjacent_api: n/a: the reference fix leaves the generic public copy/remove exports on their original no-boundary behaviour, and no tested property depends on them, so an adjacent-API regression cannot be expressed in this task.
